svg.title: Past experience
svg.desc: Past experience. Ai Engineer Intern, Qualcomm: AI-assisted browser automation for pre-silicon chip-design tools: engineers drive internal web portals in natural language. Built and compared an LLM bridge and a stateful agentic Chrome extension, with per-page guardrails and mandatory user approval. Highlight: 53 browser-automation playbooks authored. Ai Research Intern, Boolean Lab · Ucsd Health: Self-supervised computer vision for colon-tissue analysis: DINOv3-7B Vision Transformers fine-tuned with LoRA (75% less memory) plus a Mask2Former head, cutting manual annotation time by 90%. Highlight: 81% miou in crypt-level segmentation. Software Engineer, Open Financial Technologies: Two years on a neobanking platform after an internship: multi-modal invoice AI, payroll and payment-gateway work, and RBI-compliant risk controls protecting 50K+ users. Highlight: 92% of invoices auto-converted. Deep Learning Research Intern, Pucho Digital Healthcare: Deep learning for healthcare: in-silico mRNA vaccine design and explainable computer vision for disease-cell detection in MRI scans, using XAI to justify predictions. Highlight: 96.55% sensitivity in disease-cell detection. Data Science Intern, Analytics Labs: Predictive and anomaly-detection models across epidemiology, finance and predictive maintenance, including 89%-accurate COVID-19 spread forecasts from a hybrid statistical and deep-learning model. Highlight: 98.5% recall on credit-card fraud.
